packageRules.description: Automerge patch-level mise tool bumps only. The mise manager can refresh mise.lock via `mise lock` (lib/modules/manager/mise/artifacts.ts), but that only runs if the Renovate host's allowedUnsafeExecutions includes "mise" -- a self-hosted/admin setting, not something this repo's config controls or can confirm. Scoping automerge to patch bumps limits the blast radius on the chance the lockfile silently isn't refreshed.

Minor/major mise bumps always get a reviewable PR. This repo bootstraps two of David's real machines (macOS daily driver + Windows work machine) via `mise install`, so a larger version jump merging unattended is more blast radius than is worth it.
GitHub Actions bumps never automerge. Actions execute with repo permissions in CI, so a version bump deserves a human look before it runs.
